notes.title: EA Update #10
notes.notes: [p]With five recent additions, the FlipScapes Soundtrack has reached its final total of 30 tracks. Some of them are part of the newly released levels.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Level[/b][/p][p]Gliding Ice is located on the snow planet. Ready for some air hockey?  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43064874/5ce240a7b3e23d76ae93881e4484ad2213809cb6.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Using a gamepad to move through menus feels more fluid, and new focus indicators are easier to read.[/p][/*][*][p]Callisto's passive ability is now "Restore full energy upon collecting every letter."[/p][/*][*][p]Aukai’s passive ability is now “Collect all letters to awaken Abyssal Fish.”[/p][/*][*][p]Switching to "Bar control" from "Jump" now rewards you with +50% score. [/p][/*][*][p]Power icon art has been updated. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The second tutorial level has been refined, and the game now halts briefly to give players time to read the instructions. [/p][/*][*][p]The plant-themed levels have been refreshed with updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Both old and new Micro Games have been added to many levels.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fix & Technical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated Unreal Engine to 5.6.1[/p][/*][*][p]Updated EOS SDK to version 1.17.1.3, compatible with the upcoming certificate signing change.[/p][/*][*][p]Physics precision has been slightly enhanced. After the recent engine update, physics behaved unexpectedly, and the new settings aim to correct that. The ball’s physics body solver iterations for position and velocity are increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements throughout the UE 5.6 engine brought higher overall performance and also longer battery life on the Steam Deck, still holding a steady 60 FPS.[/p][/*][*][p]The optional frame generation setting, when enabled, is further halving the load. Default is still set to off, prioritizing input.[/p][/*][*][p]Frame Generation and the new ML-accelerated AMD FSR 4 upscaling algorithm are now within a single plugin. (FSR 4 includes FSR 3 Upscaling which is used when not running on an AMD Radeon RX 9000 series or better GPU.)[/p][/*][*][p]The process of saving files to disk is now asynchronous for smoother operation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused certain hardware having trouble loading. The read/write timing limitations are now accounted for.[/p][/*][*][p]A compact widget now makes the Save and Load status visible, helping you notice failed uploads and follow retry attempts.[/p][/*][*][p]Network status is visible as a small green dot in the lower left corner, signaling internet connectivity updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Spinners now treat the ball’s physics body as having infinite mass, which prevents stuck issues. [/p][/*][*][p]The size of the in-level character widget has been adjusted for each level.[/p][/*][*][p]Jumping now responds faster to slight movements of the gamepad thumbstick.[/p][/*][*][p]Flippers now display the "prediction guide" for every ball, including those in mid-air and those about to be hit.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ace Score is now easier to achieve after fixing a related bug.[/p][/*][*][p]New graphics options have been added: "Max FPS" and "Upscaler Quality". An indicator now also appears when a Steam Deck is detected, confirming optimal settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Contextual hiding of the mouse cursor now works as intended for Mouse&Keyboard.[/p][/*][*][p]Many UI widgets have been refined and optimized further. Dead zone for gamepad thumbstick navigation is updated.[/p][/*][*][p]PSOs updated for both AMD and Nvidia.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: EA Update #9
notes.notes:
[p]2D microgames have been added, which are short, fast-paced minigames. When a microgame begins, the main game pauses. When the microgame ends, the result triggers an event and the main game resumes.
[/p][p]Right now, you can access three of them in the first world. These are also part of the game's demo.
[/p][p]Enjoy catchy tunes from the soundtrack while playing the microgames![/p][p][/p][p][b]General[/b]  [/p][list][*][p] "RichText" is now implemented, making text way richer. Effects, icons and emojis are now used inline with text. This is mostly seen in chat bubbles.[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Level changes[/b]  [/p][list][*][p] Discover the new 2D microgames! Just grab the special green pickup found throughout many levels.[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Bug Fix & Technical[/b]  [/p][list][*][p] Several smaller issues from the previous update have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck compatibility
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Steady 60 FPS on the Steam Deck!
[*] The frame generation feature is now primarily for conserving battery life when needed. When enabled, the system produces 45 real frames and 15 generated frames, resulting in a smooth 60 FPS output. Please note that you don't need to enable frame generation to hit the frame rate cap of 60.
[*] The first time you launch the game, it may take about a minute to complete initial runtime caching. During this time, most calculations are pre-processed to ensure smoother gameplay going forward.
[/list]

notes.title: EA Update #8
notes.notes:
We’re back after a short break with a fresh update! This release focuses primarily on technical improvements, along with a few minor content changes.

The UI and Input subsystems are now fully updated to the newest Unreal Engine standards, delivering greater stability, better performance, and a more unified experience.

[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] Characters become available as you unlock new worlds.
[*] Newly unlocked characters have a dialogue.
[*] You can now view a new controller scheme infographic through the game’s options menu.
[*] You can now easily switch between "Jump" and "Bar Control" mechanics with a simple checkbox. Choose the style that fits you best!
[/list]

[b]Level changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Improvements have been made to the plant boss fight.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fix & Technical[/b]

[list]
[*] Enhanced Input is now working together with Common UI, natively.
[*] The action bar displays all possible action buttons, always aware of context.
[*] Loading time for levels has been optimized.
[*] The loading screen now displays the number of precompiles remaining.
[*] New loading screen images.
[*] Aspect ratios all the way from 16:9 to 32:9 are supported. Super ultra wide is accounted for in the UI.
[*] Flipper trigger button threshold adjusted for gamepads, feeling more responsive.
[*] CPU optimizations are now baked into the different graphics scalability presets.
[*] Unreal Engine version 5.5.
[*] DLSS and FSR updated to latest versions. FSR UI extraction is now enabled.
[*] Steady 60 FPS on the Steam Deck! The frame generation feature is now primarily for conserving battery life when needed.
[*] EOS and Steam SDK updated.
[*] Auth Expiration bug fix.
[/list]

notes.title: EA Update #7
notes.notes:
[b]New Level[/b]

The pizzeria is now open, and the first level is available to enjoy. Each ingredient interacts uniquely, and clearing the plate is your key to victory!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/83q7Zwr.png[/img]

This is just a snack. And don't worry, the main course is on the way. More food-themed levels are currently in development and set to be released in the next update.

[b]New Difficulty Modes[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xrQ2CqE.png[/img]

A major gameplay difference occurs between Normal and Hard mode. In Hard mode, you’ll be controlling the "Bar" between the flippers instead of having the jump ability. This leads to a very different gameplay experience. Log in to explore all the modes! Your feedback on this is highly valued.

[b]Level changes[/b]

Most levels have received minor updates to ensure compatibility with the new difficulty options.

[b]Bug Fix & Technical[/b]

[list]
[*] EOS SDK and bootstrapper have been updated to the newest version.
[*] Steam Deck users won’t be prompted for Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime installation anymore.
[*] Fixed an input delay bug affecting the flippers, cutting down a few milliseconds.
[/list]

notes.title: EA Update #6
notes.notes:
[b]Regions and ratings[/b]

FlipScapes has updated global product ratings by IARC—have a look!
[url=https://i.imgur.com/LXPgrBG.jpeg]Link to image[/url]

[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] Sound effects have undergone an update. This is part of our ongoing effort to continually improve the auditory experience.
[*] The UI element displaying the jump cooldown has a new look.
[/list]

[b]Levels[/b]

[list]
[*] Crypt Shade - Improved layout, added a ramp, spinners and introduced a brand-new Coffin asset. Plus, the boss mechanic has been reworked.
[*] Nudge Nudge - Renamed to "Lost Fleet". You can now destroy the pirate ship.
[*] Levels with vine borders now have improved readability, with the vines standing out more clearly against the green background.
[*] Ace Score has been rebalanced.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fix[/b]

[list]
[*] Bricks in free fall will now block the area below them as they fall, eliminating the issue of slipping through during the animation.
[*] Aspen's projectiles can no longer bypass the petals of flowers.
[*] Fixed flickering issues on fractured meshes.
[/list]

notes.title: EA Update #5
notes.notes:
[b]Introducing the Spinner![/b]

The Spinners are located in lanes, passageways, at the base of ramps, and near entrances. It features a panel that swings and spins, with a progress bar that fills up quickly if you get a good spin!

When the Spinner's bar reaches 100%, it triggers an event, and this can happen multiple times. The panel image hints at what will be triggered. Events are designed to match the ongoing theme of the level or world.

While most Spinners last, some can become depleted. When this happens, they break apart, fall off, and you earn points for destroying them.

[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] The ending phase of a level is now more distinct, giving a brief pause upon victory and additional fireworks to celebrate. The "pegs" that provide bonus points during this victory phase are now outlined for better visibility.
[/list]

[b]Levels[/b]

[list]
[*] Multiple levels have been enhanced with the addition of new lanes and spinners, along with themed events triggered by the spinners.
[*] Updates have been applied to several areas, including camera angles, score balance, collision and stuck problems, additional rails and more.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fix & Technical[/b]

[list]
[*] The game's settings now include Frame Generation, which is disabled by default. This option is available for both AMD and Nvidia users.
[*] The navigation system has been optimized for better performance.
[/list]

notes.title: EA Update #4
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] Steam achievements are now live! Log in to sync any achievements you've previously unlocked. You'll continue to earn Epic Online Services (EOS) achievements while playing. If you've linked your Epic and Steam accounts, your save files and achievements will be shared between both platforms.
[*] Steam Avatars featuring character art are now available. They show up in the Steam Community for you to choose from when editing your profile.
[/list]

[b]Mechanics[/b]

[list]
[*] Score with your flippers by depositing bricks across them. This is a new mechanic we're testing and is likely to change.
[/list]

[b]Levels[/b]

[list]
[*] The Quarry - Scarabs added.
[*] Crypt Shade - Boss is slightly nerfed, Scarabs.
[*] Organic Sprouts - Bird update, new ending.
[*] Sand Castle - Updated objective.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fix & Technical[/b]

[list]
[*] Music volume has been normalized across all tracks.
[*] A new, more extensive framework for shader initializations has been implemented, resulting in smoother loading. Please note that this may slightly increase startup time.
[*] Motion-aware collision detection is now implemented for the majority of assets. This new method is still being evaluated.
[*] The update rate for shadows on dynamic meshes has been optimized, resolving a bottleneck issue some players were experiencing.
[*] Fixed a bug where flippers could not be used to hit enemies passing by.
[*] Snowmen correctly dampen the ball when hit.
[/list]

notes.title: EA Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
[b]Optimization[/b]

[list]
[*] Smoother performance on the Steam Deck, now running at 50-60 FPS.
[*] Significantly reduced draw calls by dynamic mesh merging.
[*] Optimized numerous shaders while maintaining perceptual quality.
[*] Increased the bundled PSO Cache.
[/list]

notes.title: EA Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]

A bundled PSO Cache for Shader Model 6 (SM6) is now included, resulting in a smoother initial gameplay experience and reduced strain on your system. While runtime caching remains enabled, most of the calculations are now pre-processed for you.


[b]Bugfix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash related to audio volume change.
[/list]

notes.title: EA Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
[b]Level changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Dusty Bones - updated layout.
[*] Lunar Adaptation - Improved boss mechanic, updated layout.
[/list]

[b]Controls[/b]
[list]
[*] z and / can be used for jumping. Also equivalent keys on other keyboard language variants.
[/list]

[b]Bugfix[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved streaming, loading and caching. Not fully done yet.
[*] New motion-aware collision detection is being tested.
[/list]

notes.title: FlipScapes Early Access
notes.notes:
[h1]FAQ: What's Next?[/h1]

Edit: All update details and patch notes are available in the community hub.

The [b]soundtrack[/b] provides a clue! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739470/FlipScapes_Soundtrack/]Link[/url]

First is to ensure everything runs smoothly. After gathering feedback from the release, we will begin rolling out regular content updates.

You can look forward to:
[list]
[*] New worlds with additional levels, bosses and mechanics
[*] Additional hero characters
[*] A new competitive challenge mode
[/list]
And some exciting new game system features.

[b]Q[/b]: How many Levels will there be in total?
[b]A[/b]: 50 is the goal for the base game.

[b]Q[/b]: The upcoming Challenge Mode, what's it like?
[b]A[/b]: Level-modifiers, progression and difficulty, rewards, global leaderboards.

[b]Q[/b]: Multiplayer modes?
[b]A[/b]: Perhaps at some point in the future. We have a couple of ideas.

[b]Q[/b]: How do I reduce input delay?
[b]A[/b]: The game utilizes Nvidia Reflex to reduce system latency on GeForce graphics cards and laptops, [i]so your actions occur quicker[/i]. For optimal performance, [b]plug in[/b] your controller or keyboard to your system. Many modern controllers, including wireless ones, offer excellent performance.

[b]Q[/b]: Fix all bugs?
[b]A[/b]: Yes, please report any issues in the community hub. Thanks!

[b]Q[/b]: Will you implement my feature request or idea for the game?
[b]A[/b]: Sure, what could possibly go wrong?

Thanks for checking out the game! Submit your feedback and help guide our development!
